import subprocess, os, re

# Run pytest and check results
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "crucible_hidden"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Pytest output:")
print(result.stdout[-500:])  # Last 500 chars

# Check if any tests passed
if 'passed' in result.stdout:
    print("\n⚠️ Some tests PASSED - need to fix")
else:
    print("\n✅ All tests fail/error as required")

# Final summary
print(f"\nReturn code: {result.returncode}")
assert result.returncode != 0, "Tests should fail"
